responsibility: Declares the COBOL front end’s diagnostic and location interface shared by the lexer, parsers, and semantic/code-generation code. It defines parser-compatible YYLTYPE/YDFLTYPE location structs, user-facing error and warning entry points routed through GCC diagnostics, helper APIs for location-aware semantic errors and unimplemented-feature reports, and debug-only location dumping and raw stderr tracing used while scanning and parsing.
